overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its Fresh Fridays Words and Music event, featuring an interview with retiring library director Barbara Kerr and a live protest music performance by Bill Kuklinski and his band.

items.title: Interview with Retiring Library Director Barbara Kerr
items.summary: Host Terry Carter interviewed retiring library director Barbara Kerr about her career, the transition of the Coffee and Books program, reading trends, and the features of Medford's new library building.

items.title: Community Center Announcements and Music Introduction
items.summary: Terry Carter shared updates on community center events, promoted the elder lunch program and memberships, and introduced Bill Kuklinski and his band for the evening's performance.

items.title: Protest Music Performance and Suffrage Poem Reading
items.summary: Bill Kuklinski and his band performed a selection of historical protest songs, interspersed with Terry Carter reading a suffrage-themed poem titled 'Heart and Home'.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Future Events
items.summary: Terry Carter thanked Barbara Kerr and the band, and announced that the upcoming April event would feature poetry in celebration of National Poetry Month.
